text.arabic_uthmani: فَلَنُذِيقَنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ عَذَابًۭا شَدِيدًۭا وَلَنَجْزِيَنَّهُمْ أَسْوَأَ ٱلَّذِى كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ

words.gloss_range: consequence and sequence particle; it makes the ayah answer the preceding hostile speech
words.prose: {{ar:فَ}} ({{tr:fa}}) opens 41:27 as consequence from the hostile strategy in 41:26. Before any punishment noun appears, the particle tells the reader that what follows is an answer to prior speech: attempted domination becomes divinely announced consequence.

topics.headline: opening consequence from 41:26
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah starts as the consequence of the hostile strategy in 41:26, not as a detached punishment notice.
topics.reason: The particle is parsed as a prefixed conjunction at the start of the first emphatic verbal clause, and the CRITICAL rows consistently tie it to consequence across the 41:26 to 41:27 boundary.

words.gloss_range: emphatic lām prefixed to the first future verb

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: causative tasting in an emphatic future frame, with recipients and tasted content both governed locally

words.prose: The first {{ar:لَ}} ({{tr:la}}) fuses certainty to the coming verb. With the heavy ending on {{ar:نُذِيقَنَّ}} ({{tr:nudhīqanna}}), it gives the first consequence an oath-like force rather than the feel of a neutral future.

topics.headline: first emphatic certainty marker
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the first threat is grammatically framed as solemnly certain before the tasting verb even arrives.
topics.reason: QAC and translation support identify emphatic lām with final heavy nūn on the following verb, matching the CRITICAL oath-answer and certainty rows.

words.gloss_range: causative tasting in an emphatic future frame, with recipients and tasted content both governed locally
words.root_gloss_range: tasting, sampling, and direct experience; the local Form IV frame selects caused experience rather than bare tasting

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: indefinite accusative punishment as the content made tasted, qualified by the following severity adjective

words.prose: {{ar:نُذِيقَنَّ}} ({{tr:nudhīqanna}}) makes punishment caused experience: the divine speaker causes the defined group to taste, and {{ar:عَذَابًۭا}} ({{tr:ʿadhāban}}) supplies what is tasted. The taste image keeps judgment bodily and perceptual, while the qiraat contrast with a recompense opening shows why the received wording preserves sensory punishment before the accounting clause. Across the 41:26 to 41:27 boundary, hoped overcoming is answered by imposed tasting, and the heavy ending makes that caused experience sound sealed rather than tentative.

topics.headline: direct divine caused tasting
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that punishment is administered as caused experience: the speaker causes the named group to taste a specified content.
topics.reason: The verb is Form IV with two local objects, so the caused-experience reading is grammatically licensed and stronger than a generic punishment verb.

topics.headline: taste makes judgment felt
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the warning answers denial by perception and bodily contact, not only by a legal announcement.
topics.reason: The local object {{ar:عَذَابًۭا}} ({{tr:ʿadhāban}}) and the root profile support punishment as felt tasting, with the taste-punishment pairing reinforced by distributional evidence.

topics.headline: received tasting over recompense variant
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the received wording preserves a sensory first consequence before the accounting clause, while the variant shows how close a repeated recompense opening could have been.
topics.reason: The qiraat contrast is valid as apparatus: it highlights the received split between caused tasting and later recompense without replacing the canonical local parse.

words.gloss_range: masculine plural relative pronoun serving as the first object and defined by the following denial clause

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: completed collective denial inside the relative clause; objectless here and defined by the surrounding discourse

words.prose: {{ar:ٱلَّذِينَ}} ({{tr:alladhīna}}) is the recipient head under the caused-tasting verb, then it waits for {{ar:كَفَرُوا۟}} ({{tr:kafarū}}) to define the group. The same class associated with the strategy of 41:26 now appears as object, so referential continuity becomes role reversal.

topics.headline: relative head as caused-tasting recipient
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the disbelieving group is grammatically made the recipient of caused tasting before the punishment content is named.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence makes this relative pronoun the first object of the causative verb, so recipienthood is not inferred loosely.

topics.headline: identity defined by the following denial clause
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the punished class is identified internally by a relative clause rather than introduced as a bare label.
topics.reason: The relative clause {{ar:كَفَرُوا۟}} ({{tr:kafarū}}) is syntactically tied to the pronoun and defines the object group.

topics.headline: same group reverses role from 41:26
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the speakers associated with the hostile strategy in 41:26 reappear as affected recipients in 41:27.
topics.reason: The boundary row supplies the 41:26 to 41:27 role shift, and local syntax confirms object status in the new clause.

words.gloss_range: completed collective denial inside the relative clause; objectless here and defined by the surrounding discourse
words.root_gloss_range: covering, denial, refusal, and expiation-related removal; the local perfect relative clause selects culpable denial, not expiation

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: imperfect action verb under the auxiliary, closing the ayah on repeated practice

words.prose: {{ar:كَفَرُوا۟}} ({{tr:kafarū}}) defines the object group by completed collective denial. The root image of covering survives as active refusal, while the local tasted severe-punishment frame blocks expiation or cleansing branches. Structurally, the ayah starts the human profile with denial but drives toward {{ar:يَعْمَلُونَ}} ({{tr:yaʿmalūn}}), so identity is measured through sustained practice; the contrast with confession in 41:30 remains in the background.

topics.headline: settled collective denial defines the group
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that denial is presented as an established collective qualification, not a passing possibility.
topics.reason: The perfect plural verb in the relative clause supplies a completed collective predicate for the preceding relative head.

topics.headline: covering image narrowed to culpable denial
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices denial as active covering and refusal, while the local punishment context blocks the expiation branch of the root family.
topics.reason: The broader root can include removal or expiation, but this relative clause and the following punishment/recompense frame select culpable disbelief.

topics.headline: denial feeds punishment and contrast fields
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the denial label is not isolated: it feeds the tasted severe punishment and stands against the later confession contrast in 41:30.
topics.reason: Co-occurrence rows link the root to punishment and tasting, while supplied references connect 41:27 with 14:7 and the contrast in 41:30.

topics.headline: identity opens what action closes
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah moving from denial as identity to practice as record, so belief-label and deeds are held together.
topics.reason: The word appears early inside the object phrase, while the ayah closes on {{ar:يَعْمَلُونَ}} ({{tr:yaʿmalūn}}), supporting the CRITICAL structural arc.

words.gloss_range: indefinite accusative punishment as the content made tasted, qualified by the following severity adjective
words.root_gloss_range: punishment/torment and a distinct sweetness/freshness branch; local syntax and adjective select punitive pain

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: indefinite accusative adjective locked to the punishment noun as its internal severity

words.prose: {{ar:عَذَابًۭا}} ({{tr:ʿadhāban}}) is the tasted content after the recipients have been named. Its indefiniteness leaves the punishment qualitatively open, then {{ar:شَدِيدًۭا}} ({{tr:shadīdan}}) locks that open field into severe pain. The wider root family may include freshness or sweetness elsewhere, but caused tasting plus severity selects punitive experience here; the formula also recalls tasting-punishment links such as 3:106, where tasting is commanded, while 41:27 makes it administered causation within the same-surah punishment movement of 41:16, 41:17, and 41:50.

topics.headline: punishment as the tasted content
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that punishment is the content administered through the tasting verb, not a separate verdict after the verb.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence makes the noun the explicit content object of the causative tasting verb, with the recipients already named before it.

topics.headline: open-ended punishment narrowed by severity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the indefinite noun opens a qualitative punishment field that the following adjective locks into severe force.
topics.reason: The noun and adjective agree in accusative indefiniteness, so the phrase works as one indefinite severe object.

topics.headline: punishment branch over sweetness branch
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the root-family contrast: the local word selects punitive pain precisely where the wider family could include freshness or sweetness elsewhere.
topics.reason: The adjective {{ar:شَدِيدًۭا}} ({{tr:shadīdan}}) and caused-tasting governance block any pleasant branch and keep only adverse punishment active.

topics.headline: tasting and punishment fuse perception with penalty
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a recurring taste-punishment formula, with 41:27 making it an emphatic caused experience rather than only an addressed command.
topics.reason: The supplied rows connect this phrase to punishment-taste patterns including 3:106 and same-surah punishment movement at 41:16, 41:17, and 41:50.

topics.headline: affected group precedes tasted content
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the order: the seized group is named before the punishment content lands as a compact noun-adjective beat.
topics.reason: The first object precedes the punishment noun, and the noun-adjective phrase closes the first clause before the second consequence begins.

words.gloss_range: indefinite accusative adjective locked to the punishment noun as its internal severity
words.root_gloss_range: binding, tightening, strengthening, hardness, and intensity; locally selected as severe constricting force

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: coordination particle adding a second emphatic consequence clause without equating it with the first

words.prose: {{ar:شَدِيدًۭا}} ({{tr:shadīdan}}) is not a separate event; agreement makes it internal to the punishment being tasted. Its root field gives severity the feel of tightening, hardening pressure, and it seals the first consequence before {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) opens measured recompense. The severe-punishment register is placed inside caused tasting, answers kufr contexts such as 14:7, and turns strength-language from 41:15 against the deniers.

topics.headline: severity locked inside the punishment phrase
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that severity is part of what is tasted, not an afterthought or a second event.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks adjective agreement with the punishment noun in case, gender, and indefiniteness.

topics.headline: root pressure makes severity constricting
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices severity as tightening, hardening force, not merely a larger amount of punishment.
topics.reason: The sh-d-d branch range supports binding, strengthening, and hardness, and the local adjective selects that range as punishment intensity.

topics.headline: severe punishment formula turned experiential
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that a familiar severe-punishment register is placed inside caused tasting and turned against strength-language earlier in 41:15.
topics.reason: The rows connect severe punishment with kufr in 14:7 and with the same-surah strength contrast in 41:15; local syntax keeps the claim to formula and contrast, not root activation beyond the adjective.

topics.headline: severity seals the first clause before accounting
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the first consequence lands on intensity before the ayah pivots to measured recompense.
topics.reason: The adjective is the last word of the first punishment-object phrase before the coordinating particle opens the second clause.

words.gloss_range: coordination particle adding a second emphatic consequence clause without equating it with the first
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) coordinates the second emphatic clause with the first. It stacks recompense onto tasted punishment without making the two mechanisms identical: one clause gives felt consequence, the next gives calibrated repayment.

topics.headline: coordination stacks distinct consequences
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that tasted punishment and measured recompense are added together without being collapsed into synonyms.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence coordinates the recompense verb with the tasting verb, while the first object phrase is already complete before the particle.

words.gloss_range: repeated emphatic lām prefixed to the recompense verb

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: emphatic future recompense verb with attached recipients and an explicit worst-deed measure

words.prose: The second {{ar:لَ}} ({{tr:la}}) mirrors the first emphatic marker and gives {{ar:نَجْزِيَنَّهُمْ}} ({{tr:najziyannahum}}) the same surface certainty. The shift from the uncertain hope of 41:26 to repeated emphatic certainty in 41:27 is part of the boundary reversal.

topics.headline: mirrored certainty for recompense
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the accounting clause receives the same emphatic certainty as the tasted-punishment clause, reversing the uncertain hope of 41:26.
topics.reason: The second lām is attached to the recompense verb and reinforced by heavy nūn, matching the first emphatic architecture and the boundary contrast with 41:26.

words.gloss_range: emphatic future recompense verb with attached recipients and an explicit worst-deed measure
words.root_gloss_range: repayment, requital, recompense, and sufficiency; local context selects adverse accounting while preserving the broader reward/penalty range

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: accusative elative measure of recompense, completed by the following relative clause

words.prose: {{ar:نَجْزِيَنَّهُمْ}} ({{tr:najziyannahum}}) keeps the same recipients inside the verb through the attached pronoun, then turns to {{ar:أَسْوَأَ}} ({{tr:aswaʾa}}) for the measure. The root can cover reward or penalty, but denial and worstness narrow it here to adverse settlement; the heavy ending also seals that accounting as future-certain rather than secondary. The word keeps tasting and accounting distinct: 16:97 rewards by the best, 41:27 reverses the measure to the worst, and 41:28 will name the recompense explicitly.

topics.headline: recipients and measure inside one accounting frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the same group remains personally present as recipients while the following elative supplies the measure of repayment.
topics.reason: The object suffix is syntactically forced as recipient, and the following accusative elative is the explicit object or recompense measure.

topics.headline: recompense root narrowed by adverse context
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices recompense as a settled accounting, while the surrounding denial and worstness specify that the accounting is adverse here.
topics.reason: The root can cover reward or penalty, but the local objects and moral measure select adverse requital without making the root intrinsically negative.

topics.headline: second heavy nūn seals accounting
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that recompense is future-facing but sealed, not a secondary possibility after sensory punishment.
topics.reason: The imperfect verb carries final heavy nūn and is paired with the prefixed lām, matching the surface-force support.

topics.headline: best-deeds formula reversed and carried to 41:28
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that recompense language which can reward by the best in 16:97 is reversed here toward the worst, then picked up as named recompense in 41:28.
topics.reason: The supplied rows cite 16:97 for the best-deeds counterpart and 41:28 for the next-ayah recompense noun, so both contrasts are retained with concrete references.

topics.headline: tasting remains distinct from accounting
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah shifting from felt punishment to calibrated repayment, with variant evidence showing that the received wording avoids doubling the recompense verb.
topics.reason: Coordination adds this verb as a distinct second frame, and the qiraat contrast functions as apparatus for the received split rather than a replacement parse.

words.gloss_range: accusative elative measure of recompense, completed by the following relative clause
words.root_gloss_range: badness, harm, ugliness, and moral injury; the local elative selects the maximum adverse pole

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: singular relative pronoun completing the elative by supplying its deed-domain

words.prose: {{ar:أَسْوَأَ}} ({{tr:aswaʾa}}) occupies the measure slot after recompense and waits for {{ar:ٱلَّذِى}} ({{tr:alladhī}}) to supply the deed-domain. The elative grades the record by maximum moral harm and ugliness, not by quantity alone. A variant can make a broader field of bad acts audible, but the received form keeps the rare elative maximum in focus; its hamza gives the pivot into worstness a sharp audible break. In 39:35 the worst is erased for believers, while 41:27 makes the worst the basis of repayment.

topics.headline: worstness as governed measure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the worst is not a loose description; it occupies the governed measure slot of recompense.
topics.reason: The accusative elative follows the recompense verb as object or measure and is completed by the relative complement.

topics.headline: badness graded by harm and ugliness
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the scale of repayment as moral damage and ugliness, not mere quantity of misdeeds.
topics.reason: The s-w-ʾ branch range supports badness, harm, and ugliness, while the elative form selects the maximum adverse pole.

topics.headline: variant broadens hearing toward bad acts
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the variant can make a field of bad acts audible, while the received form keeps the elative maximum in focus.
topics.reason: The variant is useful as contrast only; the received local form remains the singular elative that governs the relative domain.

topics.headline: rare worst-measure reverses 39:35
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that a marked rare elative reverses the mercy pattern of 39:35: the worst is not erased here but becomes the measure of recompense.
topics.reason: The exact adj_comp profile is low-occurrence, and the supplied rows cite 39:35 as the opposite outcome for the same evaluative pole.

topics.headline: hamza marks the pivot into worstness
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a sharp audible break at the pivot from recompense verb to worst-deed measure.
topics.reason: The phonetic row is locally tied to the surface form and supports sound texture without controlling lexical sense.

words.gloss_range: singular relative pronoun completing the elative by supplying its deed-domain
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلَّذِى}} ({{tr:alladhī}}) completes the elative by opening the domain from which worstness is measured. Its singular form gathers the following habitual plural actions into one measurable record, so the ayah does not leave evil abstract; it unpacks the recompense standard through the closing clause.

topics.headline: relative clause supplies the deed-domain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that worstness is measured from the enacted record that follows, not left as abstract evil.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence makes the pronoun genitive after the construct elative and object of the final action verb inside the relative clause.

words.gloss_range: past auxiliary with plural subject, setting up habitual action with the following imperfect
words.root_gloss_range: being, occurrence, state, and situatedness; locally lightened into an aspectual auxiliary for durable past practice

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: imperfect action verb under the auxiliary, closing the ayah on repeated practice

words.prose: {{ar:كَانُوا۟}} ({{tr:kānū}}) sets up past habitual action with the following imperfect. The broader being-field is lightened into aspect here: it supplies duration and continuity while {{ar:يَعْمَلُونَ}} ({{tr:yaʿmalūn}}) carries the ethical content. The same plural group remains active, and the habitual-deed formula that can reward best works in 16:97 is redirected here toward worstness while continuing the action/testimony thread from 41:20 and 41:22. Its long vowel cadence also holds the final ledger frame open before the closing action lands.

topics.headline: past auxiliary makes repeated practice
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that recompense answers a durable pattern of doing, not one isolated lapse.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence identify the word as an auxiliary with the following imperfect, marking habitual or durative past action.

topics.headline: being lightens into aspect
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the word carrying duration while the following action verb carries the ethical content.
topics.reason: The local predicate relation makes the verb auxiliary rather than a heavy existential predicate, while the root field still supports continuity.

topics.headline: same plural group continues into the record
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the same group defined by denial remains the doer of the final deed-record.
topics.reason: The plural ending supplies a recoverable subject routed back to the earlier relative group.

topics.headline: habitual formula reversed and tied to 41:20/41:22
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the familiar habitual-deeds frame, rewarded by best deeds in 16:97, is attached here to worstness and continues the action/testimony thread from 41:20 and 41:22.
topics.reason: The supplied rows cite 16:97 for the positive counterpart and 41:20/41:22 for same-surah record language, while local syntax keeps this as formulaic background.

topics.headline: auxiliary opens the final ledger frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the final clause being prepared before the closing action verb lands as accumulated conduct.
topics.reason: The auxiliary begins the final predicate frame under the relative pronoun, and the phonetic row supports cadence as secondary surface pressure.

words.gloss_range: imperfect action verb under the auxiliary, closing the ayah on repeated practice
words.root_gloss_range: work, doing, operation, and produced action; locally selected as enacted conduct under recompense

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: past auxiliary with plural subject, setting up habitual action with the following imperfect

words.prose: {{ar:يَعْمَلُونَ}} ({{tr:yaʿmalūn}}) closes the ayah on repeated practice. Under {{ar:كَانُوا۟}} ({{tr:kānū}}), the imperfect makes the deed-field iterative, and the objectless action wording widens the record beyond one isolated act. After two emphatic divine verbs, the last heard unit is human doing, and the plural ending keeps the same group collectively tied to the judged action. Denial becomes enacted output, while recompense, worstness, and action converge into an ethical ledger that reverses best-work formulas such as 16:97 and answers the hoped domination of 41:26.

topics.headline: imperfect makes practice iterative
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final action is a repeated practice-field rather than one completed deed.
topics.reason: The imperfect is the predicate of the past auxiliary and has the relative pronoun as object, so it completes a habitual action domain.

topics.headline: final word leaves action in focus
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that after two emphatic divine verbs, the ayah ends on human action and collective accountability.
topics.reason: The subject remains morphologically recoverable from the plural ending, and the word is the final surface unit of the ayah.

topics.headline: doing turns denial into output
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the movement from inner or identity-level denial to enacted output as the basis of recompense.
topics.reason: The root range supports produced action, and the ayah structure begins the human label with denial but closes with doing.

topics.headline: work, worstness, and recompense converge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the second half forming an ethical ledger: recompense, worstness, and habitual action converge as one accounting mechanism.
topics.reason: The supplied co-occurrence and synthesis rows explicitly join the action root with recompense and badness in this closing frame.

topics.headline: habitual-work formula answers hope from 41:26
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the adverse reversal of reward formulas such as 16:97 and the boundary answer to the hoped domination of 41:26.
topics.reason: The rows cite 16:97, 41:20, and 41:26, and local closure on the action verb supports the boundary and formula payoffs without changing the parse.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The causative tasting verb at word 1 governs severe punishment at words 4-5.
baseline_models.mechanism: The paired emphatic futures turn punishment from a reported destination into compelled bodily knowledge: the addressees are made to register it as directly as taste, with severity supplying force and resistance.

activation_trace.role: Mouth-tasting supplies literal bodily contact and makes the penalty personally registered rather than merely announced.
Learning a thing by undergoing it expands taste into experiential verification and drives the threat's epistemic force.
Painful punishment supplies the adverse object that the tasting construction forces into experience.
Concentrated strength and hardness make the experienced penalty resistant to evasion or attenuation.

changed_reading.before: The disbelievers will receive a severe punishment.
changed_reading.after: They will be forced to know the severe punishment through direct embodied experience; warning becomes verified sensation.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The second emphatic clause joins recompense at word 6 to the worst at word 7 of what they habitually did at words 9-10.
baseline_models.mechanism: Recompense answers intentional practice with a commensurate return, while the superlative selects the ugliest register within an accumulated history of work. The verse therefore relates penalty to practiced action rather than attaching it arbitrarily to a label.

activation_trace.role: Reciprocal payment for an act supplies the action-to-return relation that organizes the second clause.
Ugliness and bad quality supply the scale on which their practiced acts are selected as worst.
Occurrence through past time turns the deeds into an established history rather than a single isolated act.
Purposive action supplies the accountable material whose quality determines the return.

changed_reading.before: God will punish them for their deeds.
changed_reading.after: The return is calibrated to the ugliest quality of an established practice of intentional acts.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Those designated by the covering root at word 3 are made to taste the worst of their own work.
baseline_models.mechanism: Covering and truth-blocking create distance from what is rejected; compelled tasting cancels that distance. The concealed ugly content of their practice becomes an unavoidable encounter.

activation_trace.role: Covering supplies the protective or concealing motion that the later forced encounter reverses.
Blocking acknowledged truth identifies the covering as an epistemic act, not only a static group label.
A shameful thing normally kept covered supplies an exploratory exposure image for the worst content of their work.
Intentional work keeps the exposure model attached to what they themselves practiced.

changed_reading.before: Disbelievers are a named class who are punished.
changed_reading.after: Those who actively covered truth lose the distance created by covering and must encounter the ugly content of their own practice.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier challenge of work against work and the contrasting promise of an uncut wage establish a surah-wide sorting mechanism: purposive practice issues in a corresponding return. The focus verse occupies the adverse side of that mechanism.

activation_trace.role: Purposive work anchors the focus clause in accountable practice.
The paired command and answer present opposed parties as deliberately carrying out their respective work.
Righteous intentional action supplies the positive comparison class for the focus verse's worst work.
A wage or return for work makes the action-to-outcome relation explicit on the positive side.
The image of cutting off supplies the negated limit on righteous reward and sharpens the contrast with adverse recompense.

structural_cues: 41:5 repeats the work root as a reciprocal challenge, and 41:8 immediately couples righteous work to an uncut wage.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies opposed work and an explicit positive wage; I infer a shared sorting framework whose negative arm appears in 41:27. A live alternative is that these are separate rhetorical contrasts rather than one accounting mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The focus verse independently threatens repayment for bad deeds.
changed_reading.after: It resolves an earlier contest of practices within a two-sided work-to-return system: righteous work receives an uncut wage, while the opposing practice returns in its worst register.

context_deltas.mechanism: The claim of superior strength is answered by greater strength and then by an episode in which punishment is made experientially known. The focus adjective severe therefore does more than intensify pain: it recalls a demonstrated contest in which arrogant power failed under load.

activation_trace.role: Concentrated strength anchors the focus penalty to the earlier dispute over which strength can prevail.
The repeated strength comparison supplies the explicit contested scale later carried by severe punishment.
Strength gathered like strands under tension makes the boast and its answer a test of load-bearing power.
A prior caused experience of punishment supplies a demonstrated precedent for the focus threat.
The repeated painful penalty connects the historical demonstration directly to the focus object.
Public abasement makes the failed strength claim visible rather than leaving the defeat private.
What was actively acquired ties the demonstrated penalty back to the agents' own conduct.

structural_cues: 41:15 poses and answers the question of greater strength.
41:16-17 immediately narrate caused tasting and punishment as the consequence of acquisition.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a strength boast, its correction, and a caused tasting sequence; I infer that severity in 41:27 reactivates this failed stress test. The alternative is that the earlier episode serves only as an example of punishment without modifying the adjective.

changed_reading.before: Severe only marks a high degree of pain.
changed_reading.after: Severity also answers the addressees' power claim: punishment is the load under which their asserted strength is experimentally disproved.

context_deltas.mechanism: Hearing, sight, and skin become present witnesses to the very work named in the focus verse, and attempted concealment fails when the body is made articulate. The later tasting penalty consequently uses the same embodied interface that authenticates the deed record.

activation_trace.role: Intentional work anchors the model to the focus verse's object of recompense.
Presence with direct witnessing turns past work into evidence carried by those who underwent it.
The body's covering surface becomes an evidentiary organ and links judgment to embodied experience.
The exact recurrence of work identifies what the bodily witnesses attest.
Sign-bearing articulation supplies the mechanism by which mute bodily evidence becomes intelligible testimony.
Attempted covering supplies the failed concealment that bodily testimony defeats.

structural_cues: 41:20 says the organs testify concerning what they used to do; 41:21 makes them speak; 41:22 denies that concealment could prevent their testimony.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies bodily witnesses, articulation, failed concealment, and the same work formula; I infer that the body functions as a self-authenticating deed record and later as the site of tasting. A live alternative is that the organs are external witnesses to acts rather than carriers of an inscription.

changed_reading.before: Their works are external facts consulted before punishment.
changed_reading.after: Their practiced acts become bodily self-evidence: the sensorium that witnessed the deeds authenticates them and then becomes the site of compelled tasting.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding strategy blocks reception by commanding non-hearing and flooding the message with noise in pursuit of dominance. The focus reverses agency and sensory control: those who tried to prevent an auditory experience are made to undergo an unavoidable gustatory one.

activation_trace.role: Literal tasting anchors the reversal in a second sensory channel that the addressees cannot shut down.
Truth-blocking identifies non-hearing and noise as an active denial mechanism by the same subject group.
Auditory perception supplies the reception channel they explicitly command one another to disable.
Mixed clamor supplies the active masking technique used to keep the recitation from registering.
Overpowering force supplies their intended outcome, which the compelled tasting clause reverses.

structural_cues: 41:26 and 41:27 are adjacent, retain the same subject designation, and move directly from do not hear and make noise to We will surely make them taste.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies deliberate sensory masking followed immediately by a causative sensory verb; I infer a reversal from controlled non-reception to forced reception. The alternative is that taste is only a conventional experience idiom and the auditory contrast is rhetorical rather than mechanistic.

changed_reading.before: Tasting is simply a vivid synonym for suffering punishment.
changed_reading.after: Tasting is forced reception: their campaign to stop the message from being heard ends with an experience they cannot mask, outshout, or control.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next ayah repeats recompense, identifies fire, and gives it an abiding residential horizon. This prevents the small, momentary scale of an ordinary taste from limiting the threat: tasting functions as entry into a condition that persists.

activation_trace.role: A bounded mouth-taste supplies the small-scale event whose temporal scope the following ayah enlarges.
Act-for-act recompense anchors the focus threat to the explicit identification that follows.
The doubled naming of recompense resolves the focus clause into a specified consequence.
Kindled fire supplies the concrete environment in which the focus punishment is experienced.
Persistence without quick decay expands the tasting event into an enduring condition.
Denial despite knowledge reconnects the specified consequence to the epistemic refusal that produced it.

structural_cues: 41:28 begins by identifying the preceding threat as recompense, repeats the recompense noun, and names an abode of persistence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a moment-scale tasting image followed by an abiding environment; I infer that taste marks experiential entry, not duration. The alternative is that taste already means experience without any onset implication.

changed_reading.before: They undergo a sharp but temporally unspecified taste of punishment.
changed_reading.after: The compelled taste is the experiential threshold of an abiding state, not a fleeting sample.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later maxim routes good action to the agent's own benefit and bad action upon the agent, while excluding withheld right. It clarifies the focus recompense as a non-arbitrary return curve in which practiced badness comes back upon its practitioner.

activation_trace.role: Reciprocal payment anchors the later self-return mechanism to the focus act of recompense.
Purposive action starts the explicit routing rule from deed to doer.
The agent's own self supplies the destination to which the action's value returns.
Bad quality supplies the negative payload explicitly placed upon the acting self.
Withholding a due right supplies the injustice excluded from the action-to-self routing.

structural_cues: 41:46 uses parallel for himself and upon it clauses, then denies injustice by the Lord.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies explicit directional prepositions from action to self and an exclusion of injustice; I infer that 41:27's recompense realizes this return path. The alternative is a juridical award that remains external even though it is fairly assigned.

changed_reading.before: The worst deeds serve as evidence for an externally selected sentence.
changed_reading.after: Their practiced badness is routed back upon their own selves through a recompense that withholds no right.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later ayah applies caused tasting first to mercy after harm and then to punishment after an account of work. Taste is therefore a neutral channel of knowledge by undergoing, whose polarity comes from its object; the thickening image adds material density to the focus severity.

activation_trace.role: Experiential knowledge anchors the focus threat in a channel that can carry more than pain.
The same caused-experience root carries both mercy and punishment, proving that the object rather than the channel determines valence.
Tender benefit supplies the positive object of tasting and prevents taste itself from meaning pain.
Being struck by an effect supplies the prior harmful contact against which tasted mercy is registered.
Delivered information supplies verbal disclosure of their deeds before caused tasting supplies experiential verification.
The recurrence of intentional work preserves the focus relation between what was practiced and what is experienced.
Painful punishment restores the negative object in the later near-repetition of the focus wording.
Thickness after thinness gives the punishment material density alongside the focus adjective's force.

structural_cues: 41:50 contains both tasting mercy and making the disbelievers taste punishment, then repeats the focus links among disbelief, work, tasting, and punishment.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies opposite objects governed by the same tasting root and a disclosure-before-experience sequence; I infer a neutral experiential verification channel. The alternative is that the two uses are independent conventional idioms without a designed polarity.

changed_reading.before: Taste is a figurative synonym specialized for suffering.
changed_reading.after: Taste is knowledge through undergone contact, equally able to verify mercy or punishment; in 41:27 the punitive object makes that neutral channel severe.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because bow-testing is a branch-distant image, but it is supplied for the focus tasting root and is sharpened by severe plus the nearby contest of strength. Render it only as an exploratory stress-test analogy, never as a replacement gloss for the verb.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The tasting verb at 41:27 word 1 and severe at word 5 stand near the repeated strength contest in 41:15.

activation_trace.role: Drawing or examining a bow to test it supplies the exploratory image of punishment putting a power claim under tension.
Hard strength supplies the property being tested in the focus penalty.
Gathered tensile strength supplies the nearby boast and counterclaim that the focus threat can imaginatively stress-test.

changed_reading.before: They are made to sample an intense punishment.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the punishment draws their boasted power under tension as a bow is tested, revealing that the claim cannot bear the load.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the non-dominant split mapping of the focus recompense root and combines it with later fruit imagery. It remains packet-anchored through the explicit split branch, the focus covering and work roots, and 41:47's fruit emerging from sheaths; render it as a material harvest analogy, not as an etymology or lexical equation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus sequence joins covering at word 3, recompensing at word 6, and practiced work at word 10.

activation_trace.role: Covering seed with earth supplies the concealed beginning of an exploratory cultivation sequence.
The non-dominant branch's time of cutting when growth is ripe supplies harvest as an image for recompense becoming due.
Intentional work supplies the cultivation-like process whose result eventually matures.
Emergence from concealment supplies the transition from hidden growth to exposed result.
Ripe fruit supplies the matured output of the work process.
The fruit sheath supplies the temporary covering from which the result finally emerges.

changed_reading.before: Recompense is a judicial payment assigned after completed deeds.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, practiced covering cultivates a result that ripens under its sheath, emerges, and reaches its cutting time as the worst harvest of their work.

strongest_changes: The adjacency of 41:26-27 turns tasting into forced sensory reception after deliberate non-hearing and masking noise.
The bodily testimony sequence in 41:20-22 makes practiced work self-authenticating evidence within the same sensorium that later tastes punishment.
The exact polarity in 41:50 shows taste as neutral experiential verification, carrying mercy as well as punishment.
The self-routing rule in 41:46 clarifies recompense as practiced badness returning upon its agent without withheld right.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet exposed a repeated sensory and evidentiary mechanism: blocked hearing, bodily testimony, compelled tasting, and later polarity between tasted mercy and tasted punishment.
remaining_uncertainties: The grammatical scope of worst may select the worst deeds, the worst quality of their practice, or the adverse grade of recompense.
Bodily testimony clearly authenticates work, but the stronger notion of the body storing an inscription remains a reader-supplied inference.
Whether taste marks entry into an enduring state or simply means experience remains open.
The bow-test and harvest-cut activations are deliberately contained material analogies, not lexical claims.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **The attempted control of hearing is answered through another sense.** **ذ و ق B002** supplies embodied experience, **ع ذ ب B005** punishment, and **ش د د B002** intensity. Coming directly after acoustic interference, tasting shifts judgment from a manipulable public soundscape to inescapable personal experience. I infer the sensory reversal; the packet supplies the sequence. Punishment reads as knowledge that cannot be shouted down.
2. **Recompense matches enacted harm.** **ج ز ي B001** gives recompense matching an act, **س و ء B001/B002** badness and harm, and **ع م ل B001** intentional doing. The superlative object selects the worst of the practiced pattern. I infer that judgment extracts and returns the operative quality of their work. This is not arbitrary severity but correspondential consequence.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 41:46 later generalizes the reflexive rule: sound action is for the self and evil action against it. 41:50 repeats tasting at both mercy and punishment, clarifying that experience exposes the disposition with which each state is met.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Suppressed hearing returns as unavoidable experience.** Lexically, `ذ و ق B002` is experiencing or testing, `ج ز ي B001` recompense matching an act, `ش د د B002` intensified severity, and `ع م ل B001` intentional conduct. Structurally, 41:26’s attempt to block auditory understanding is answered by tasting, a mode that cannot be drowned out by clamor; 41:28 repeats `جزاء` around the resulting dwelling. I assign tasting the role of compulsory embodied reception and recompense the role of matching output to conduct. The inferred arrow is that refusing one channel of accountable experience shifts the consequence into another. The ayah reads as sensory reversal governed by equivalence.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 41:28’s repeated recompense confirmed the matching logic, while 41:32’s guest-provision supplied the unexpected inverse: embodied outcome can be severe tasting or merciful hospitality.

Karşılık, yapılan kötülüğün etkin niteliğini seçip sahibine geri veren bir eşleşme düzeni olarak işler.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, yenilen bir şeyi ağızla tatma eylemini; ayrıca bu yolla algılanan tadı ve tadılan yiyecek miktarını birlikte gösterir. Olumsuz kalıplar ile bir şeyi azar azar tatma kullanımı bu ağızla algılama çekirdeğine bağlıdır; genel deneyim ve sınama anlamları bu dalın dışında kalır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dalın çekirdeği ağızla tatmadır; olumsuz ve aşamalı kullanımlar yalnız bu çekirdeğin kalıba bağlı gerçekleşimleridir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın biçimler ağızla tatma ve algılanan tat çekirdeğini taşır; olumsuz söz kalıpları ile azar azar tatma kullanımı ayrı ve kalıba bağlı tutulur.

concept_map.definition: Yiyecek ya da başka yenebilir bir şeyi ağızla yoklayıp tadını algılamaktır. Aynı alan, algılanan tadı ve bazı kalıplarda tadılan en küçük yiyecek miktarını da adlandırır.

facets.statement: Yenebilir bir şeyi ağızla yoklayarak tadını algılama eylemidir.
Eylemin sonucu olarak algılanan tat, bir şeyin damakta bıraktığı nitelik olarak adlandırılır.
Olumsuz söz kalıplarında tadılan şey, en küçük yiyecek miktarını veya herhangi bir lokmayı temsil eder.
Aşamalı biçim, bir şeyi birbiri ardınca küçük miktarlarda tatmayı anlatır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak çizgisi ağızla tatma eylemi ile bu eylemde algılanan tadı bir arada verir. Toplu ifade ayrıca hiçbir şey yememeyi bildiren olumsuz kalıpları ve azar azar tatma biçimini de bu çekirdeğe bağlar.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, bir kişiyi veya onun elindekini sınayıp tanımayı, insanın başına gelen kötülüğü ve ceza sonucunu bizzat yaşamasını, ayrıca sınanmış bir şeyin bilinir hâle gelmesini aynı deneyim çekirdeğinde toplar. Ağızla tatma yalnız bu genişlemenin çıkış modeli olup dalın zorunlu bedensel koşulu değildir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal doğrudan yaşama veya sınayarak öğrenme eksenindedir; sıkıntı, ceza ve sınanmışlık özel gerçekleşimlerdir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Genel deneyim çekirdeği korunur; kişi sınama, sıkıntı yaşama, ceza görme, başkasına yaşatma ve sınanmış olma anlamları kendi kalıplarına bağlı tutulur.

concept_map.definition: Bir kişiyi ya da şeyi doğrudan sınayarak tanımak veya bir olayın etkisini bizzat yaşayarak öğrenmektir. Kötülüğün ya da cezanın başa gelmesi, bunun birine yaşatılması ve bir şeyin denenip bilinir olması bu çekirdeğin özel gerçekleşimleridir.

facets.statement: Bir kişi, şey veya durum hakkında doğrudan sınama ya da yaşantı yoluyla bilgi edinilir.
Bir kişinin kendisi veya sahip olduğu şey sınanarak nasıl olduğu öğrenilir.
İnsanın başına gelen kötülük, ceza veya kötü sonuç doğrudan maruz kalınarak deneyimlenir.
Ettirgen kullanımda bir güç başkasına kötü bir durumu veya cezayı yaşatır.
Sınanmış bir iş veya şey, deneme sonucunda bilinen ve niteliği anlaşılmış sayılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Toplu kaynak ifadesi doğrudan sınama ile başa gelen bir şeyi yaşama biçimlerini ortak bir edinilmiş bilgi çekirdeğinde birleştirir. Kişi sınama, kötü sonuç ve ceza yaşama, bunları birine yaşatma ve denenmiş bir işin bilinir olması bu çekirdeğin ayrı gerçekleşimleridir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, bir şeyi örtme ve görünmez kılma çekirdeğini; zırhı giysiyle kaplama, silahla örtünme, külün toprakla kapanması ve yıldızların güneş ışığında görünmemesi gibi gerçekleşmelerle açıkça destekler.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi başka bir şeyle örterek görünmesini engellemek veya kapalı duruma getirmektir. Zırhın giysiyle, kişinin silahla ya da külün savrulan toprakla örtülmesi bu işlemin özel gerçekleşmeleridir.

facets.statement: Bir nesnenin üstünü kapatarak onu görünmez veya örtülü duruma getirme işlemi.
Zırhı giysiyle kaplama, silahla örtünme ve külün üstünün toprakla kapanması çekirdeğin özel gerçekleşmeleridir.
Güneşin yıldızları görünmez kılması da görsel örtme sonucu üzerinden bu çekirdeğe bağlanır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar örtme ve kapatma çekirdeğinde birleşir; farklı örnekler bu işlemin nesne, giysi, silah, kül ve gök görünümü üzerindeki gerçekleşmelerini gösterir.

branches.source_phrase_ar: الكافر مغيب الشمس ويقال بل البحر والنهر العظيم كافر (maqayis)؛ الكافر الليل والبحر ومغيب الشمس والكافر النهر العظيم (ayn)؛ الكافر الليل المظلم والكافر البحر والنهر العظيم (sihah)؛ الليل كافر لأنه ستر بظلمته (tahdhib)؛ وصف الليل بالكافر لستره الأشخاص والكافر للسحاب (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bu dalı inancın karşıtı ve gerçeğin örtülmesi olarak tanımlar; birliği, dinî hükmü veya peygamberliği yadsıma ile inkâr, bile bile direnme, ikiyüzlülük ve ortak koşma türlerini açıkça içerir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal dinî gerçeği ve inancı reddetmeyle sınırlıdır; nimeti yadsıma veya yalnızca genel bir gerçeği inkâr etme bunun tamamı değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın dinî reddetme çekirdeği korunur; kalben bilip söylememe, bilip kabul etmeme, dıştan inanmış görünme ve hem kalple hem dille reddetme yapıya bağlı türlerdir.

concept_map.definition: İnancı, birliği, dinî hükmü veya peygamberliği reddederek dinî gerçeği örtmek ya da kabul etmemektir. Kaynaklar bunu inkâr, bile bile direnme, ikiyüzlülük, ortak koşma ve yalanlama gibi türlere ayırır.

facets.statement: İnancın karşıtı olarak dinî gerçeği, birliği, dinî hükmü veya peygamberliği reddetme.
Kalben bilip sözle kabul etmeme, bilip boyun eğmeme, dıştan inanmış görünme ve hem kalple hem dille inkâr etme farklı türlerdir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar dalı inancın karşıtı sayar ve gerçeği örtme düşüncesiyle açıklar; toplu aktarım çeşitli inkâr, direnme ve ikiyüzlülük biçimlerini de sıralar.

concept_gloss.applicability: İnancın karşıtı olan çekirdeği ve reddedilen dinî içeriği birlikte ifade eder.

error_profile.preserves: Dinî gerçeği kabul etmeme çekirdeğini ve inanç karşıtlığını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Dalın genel dinî karşıtlık bağlamında eylem olarak çevrilmesi gerektiğinde kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: İnancı kabul etmeme ve ona karşı durma çekirdeğini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bile bile yadsıma veya direnme türünün açıklandığı bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Bilgi ile dışa vurulan ret arasındaki ayrımı korur.
error_profile.loses: İkiyüzlülük ve bütünüyle bilgisiz inkâr gibi öteki türleri dışarıda bırakır.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: kalben bildiği gerçeği diliyle kabul etmeme
gerçeği bildiği hâlde inatla kabul etmemek
gerçeği hem kalple hem dille inkâr etmek

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal özellikle dinî inancı ve gerçeği reddeder; ikiyüzlülük ve ortak koşma gibi türleri de kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal, doğruluğu bilinen herhangi bir şeyi inkâr etmeyi din alanıyla sınırlamadan anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Bilinen bir gerçeği kabul etmeme iki dalın ortak alanıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dalın dinî kapsamı ve birden çok tutum türü vardır; komşu dal ise konusu ne olursa olsun bilgiye rağmen yadsımayı merkez alır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal dinî gerçeği kabul etmemeyi ve reddetmeyi bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal haberi veya dinî gerçeği doğrulayıp kalben benimsemeyi bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal aynı kabul-ret ekseninde dinî veya doğrulanabilir içerikle ilişki kurar.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Biri gerçeği reddetme, diğeri onu doğrulayıp benimseme yönündedir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; genel yadsıma en yakın anlam komşusu, inanma ise açık karşıt kutup olduğu için yayımlandı.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الكفر نقيض الإيمان وجحود الوحدانية أو الشريعة أو النبوة والإنكار والجحود والمعاندة والنفاق والشرك والتكذيب
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس كفران النعمة وحده ولا البراءة ولا التكفير عن السيئات
branches.source_phrase_ar: الكفر ضد الإيمان سمى لأنه تغطية الحق (maqayis)؛ الكفر نقيض الإيمان والكفر أربعة أنحاء كفر الجحود وكفر المعاندة وكفر النفاق وكفر الإنكار (ayn)؛ الكفر ضد الإيمان (sihah)؛ الكفر نقيض الإيمان وكفر إنكار وكفر جحود وكفر معاندة وكفر نفاق وكفر هو شرك وكفر بكتاب الله ورسوله والتكذيب بالله (tahdhib)؛ أعظم الكفر جحود الوحدانية أو الشريعة أو النبوة (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi nimeti yadsımayı, onu örtmeyi ve gereği olan şükrü yerine getirmemeyi aynı çekirdekte birleştirir; dalın geçici çerçevesi bu koşulu doğru yansıtır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Nesne özellikle nimettir ve belirleyici sonuç şükrün terkidir; genel dinî ret bu dala kendiliğinden girmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Nimeti yadsıma çekirdeği yalın ve türemiş kullanımlarda korunur; nimetle kurulan yapı ve aşırılık bildiren kişi nitelemesi ayrı gerçekleşmelerdir.

concept_map.definition: Bir nimeti tanımamak, değerini örtmek veya onun gerektirdiği şükrü yerine getirmemektir. Bu tutumda aşırı olan kişi de aynı anlam alanında nitelenir.

facets.statement: Bir nimeti yadsıma veya şükrünü yerine getirmeyerek değerini örtme.
Nimetleri sürekli ve aşırı biçimde yadsıyan kişi bu tutumun yoğunlaşmış taşıyıcısıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar nimeti yadsımayı şükrün karşıtı sayar; örtme açıklaması, nimetin gerektirdiği şükrü yerine getirmemeyi bu karşıtlığın belirleyici davranışı yapar.

concept_gloss.applicability: Nimeti tanımama ile ona şükretmeme çekirdeğini kısa ve doğal biçimde verir.

error_profile.preserves: Nimetin inkâr edilmesini ve şükrün terk edilmesini birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir nimetin veya yapılan iyiliğin tanınmadığı gündelik bağlamlarda doğal karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Yapılan iyiliği tanımama ve karşılığında şükretmeme tutumunu korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: nimeti yadsımak ve şükrünü yerine getirmemek
iyilikleri karşılıksız ve teşekkürsüz kalan cömert adam

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal nimetin yadsınmasını ve şükrünün terkini doğrudan çekirdek yapar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal nimet yanında dostluğu kesme, felaketleri sayıp nimetleri unutma ve yardımı esirgeme gibi tutumları da kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Nimeti tanımama ve ona şükretmeme iki dalda da merkezîdir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu dal nankörlüğü daha geniş bir davranış kümesine yayar; bu dal doğrudan nimet ile şükür arasındaki ilişkiyle sınırlıdır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal nimeti tanımamayı ve şükrünü terk etmeyi bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal nimeti tanımayı, övmeyi ve şükrü sözle ya da davranışla göstermeyi bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal nimetin tanınması ve karşılığının verilmesi eksenindedir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Biri nimetin değerini örter ve şükrü bırakır; diğeri nimeti tanır ve şükrü gösterir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; daha geniş nankörlük dalı yakın eş, şükür dalı ise doğrudan karşıt kutup olarak yayımlandı.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه كفر النعمة وكفرانها وجحودها وترك شكرها والكفور في كفران النعمة
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس الكفر الديني عند الإطلاق ولا الكفارة ولا البراءة
branches.source_phrase_ar: كفران النعمة جحودها وسترها (maqayis)؛ الكفر نقيض الشكر كفر النعمة أي لم يشكرها (ayn)؛ الكفر أيضا جحود النعمة وهو ضد الشكر (sihah)؛ الكفر كفر النعمة وهو نقيض الشكر (tahdhib)؛ كفر النعمة وكفرانها سترها بترك أداء شكرها (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi sözün bir şeyden uzak olduğunu bildirme, onunla bağını reddetme ve ondan sıyrılma anlamında kullanılabildiğini açıkça söyler.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal bir inancı yadsımak değil, belirli bir şeyle bağı reddedip ondan uzaklaşmaktır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Anlam yalnızca bir şeyden uzaklaşmayı bildiren bağlı yapıda korunur; yalın köke genel bir ayrılma anlamı verilmez.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyle olan bağı reddetmek, ondan uzak olduğunu açıklamak ve sorumluluk ya da aidiyet bağından sıyrılmaktır.

facets.statement: Belirli bir şeyle bağı reddederek ondan uzaklaşma ve kendini onun dışında tutma.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar bağlı kullanımın bir şeyden uzak olduğunu ilan etme ve onunla ilişkiden sıyrılma anlamı taşıdığında birleşir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bir kişi, görüş, eylem veya sorumlulukla ilişkiyi açıkça reddeden bağlı kullanım için uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Bağı reddetme ile o bağdan uzaklaşma işlemlerini birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Aidiyet veya sorumluluk bağının reddedildiği bağlamlarda açıklayıcı karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Aidiyet bağını reddetme ve kendini dışarıda konumlandırma sonucunu korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: bir şeyle bağını reddedip ondan uzaklaşmak

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal belirli bir bağlı söz yapısında ilişkiyi reddetmeyi anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal kişi, iş, kusur ve kötülükten arınma, uzak durma, uyarma ve mazeret bildirme gibi daha geniş bir alanı kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Bir kişi veya şeyle ilişkiyi reddetme ve ondan uzak durma iki dalda ortaktır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal yapısal olarak bağlı ve dar bir ilişki reddidir; komşu dal genel uzaklık, arınmışlık ve sorumsuzluk bildirimlerini de içerir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; genel bağ kesme ve uzak durma dalı en yakın anlam sınırını verdiği için yayımlandı.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الكفر بمعنى البراءة والتنصل من الشيء أو بعضهم من بعض
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس جحود الإيمان ولا كفران النعمة ولا تغطية الشيء حسيا
branches.source_phrase_ar: يكون الكفر أيضا بمعنى البراءة (tahdhib)؛ قد يعبر عن التبري بالكفر (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bir kişiyi inançsız diye adlandırma ve onun inancı reddettiğine hükmetme işlemlerini doğrudan verir; geçici çerçeve bu katılımcı ilişkisini doğru korur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Eylem kişinin kendi reddi değil, başka bir kişinin durumu hakkında adlandırma veya hüküm vermedir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın biçimin ettirgen-hüküm verici anlamı korunur; suçlama veya zorlama gibi başka yapısal anlamlar eklenmez.

concept_map.definition: Bir kişiyi inançsız diye adlandırmak veya onun dinî gerçeği reddettiğine hükmetmektir.

facets.statement: Başka bir kişiyi inançsız diye niteleme veya bu yönde hüküm verme.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar eylemi bir kişiye inançsız nitelemesi yöneltmek veya onun hakkında bu hükmü vermek olarak açıklar.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bir başkasını dinî inancı reddeden kişi diye adlandırma veya böyle hükmetme bağlamında uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Başka bir kişi hakkında niteleme ve hüküm verme işlemini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Resmî veya öğretisel bir hükmün vurgulandığı bağlamlarda daha açık karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Kişinin dinî durumu hakkında hüküm verme yönünü açıkça korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: birini inançsız saymak veya öyle adlandırmak

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal bir kişinin dinî inancı reddettiğine ilişkin niteleme veya hüküm verir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal bir kişiye hırsızlık eylemini yükler.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dalda konuşan, başka bir kişiye olumsuz bir nitelik veya eylem isnat eder.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: İsnat yapısı ortaktır; ancak yüklenen içerik ve hükmün dinî niteliği bütünüyle farklıdır, bu yüzden olağan ikame mümkün değildir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; hırsızlık isnadı yalnızca katılımcı yapısını açıklayan yararlı bir yakın komşu olarak yayımlandı.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه أكفر الرجل بمعنى دعاه كافرا أو حكم بكفره أو نسبه إلى الكفر
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس الإلجاء إلى العصيان ولا الكفر نفسه ولا التكفير عن السيئات
branches.source_phrase_ar: أكفرت الرجل أي دعوته كافرا لا تكفر أحدا (sihah)؛ أكفره إكفارا حكم بكفره (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi başlangıçta itaat eden bir kişiyi baskıyla itaatsizliğe sürükleme sürecini açıkça belirtir; geçici çerçeve başlangıç durumu, zorlama ve sonuç ayrımını korur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Genel zorlama değildir; itaat eden kişinin zorlanarak itaatsizliğe geçirilmesi şarttır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın biçim, itaat eden kişiyi itaatsizliğe zorlama anlamıyla sınırlanır; yalnızca hüküm verme anlamına veya genel baskıya genişletilmez.

concept_map.definition: Başlangıçta itaat eden bir kişiyi baskı veya zorlamayla itaatsiz davranmaya mecbur bırakmaktır.

facets.statement: İtaat eden bir kişiyi zorlayarak itaatsizliğe geçirmek.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar aynı katılımcı değişimini verir: itaat eden kişi dış baskıyla itaatsiz davranmaya mecbur bırakılır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Başlangıçta itaat eden bir kişinin baskıyla itaatsiz davranmaya sürüklendiği bağlam için tam karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Zorlama işlemini, başlangıçtaki itaati ve itaatsizlik sonucunu korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: İtaatsizliğin açık bir başkaldırı olarak gerçekleştiği anlatı bağlamlarında kullanılabilir.

error_profile.preserves: Dış baskıyla itaatten karşı koymaya geçişi korur.
error_profile.loses: Başkaldırı düzeyine varmayan itaatsiz davranışları dışarıda bırakır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal hedefin önceden itaat etmesini ve zorlamanın onu itaatsizliğe götürmesini şart koşar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal herhangi bir kişiyi herhangi bir şeye zorlamayı genel olarak kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Bir kişiyi istemediği bir davranışa baskıyla mecbur bırakma iki dalda ortaktır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dalın başlangıç ve sonuç koşulları belirgindir; komşu dalın zorlama çekirdeğinde itaatten itaatsizliğe geçiş şartı yoktur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal sonucu doğrudan baskı ve mecbur bırakma yoluyla oluşturur.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal ayartma, aldatma veya isteği süsleme yoluyla doğru yoldan saptırmayı da kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Bir kişiyi önceki doğru veya itaatkâr durumundan uzaklaştırma iki dalda ortaktır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Burada belirleyici araç zorlamadır; komşu dalda ise yöneltme ve ayartma bulunabilir, mecbur bırakma zorunlu değildir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; genel zorlama sınırı ve zorlamasız saptırma ayrımı dalın koşullarını en iyi açıkladığı için yayımlandı.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi çiftçinin tohumu veya taneyi toprakla örtme işlemini adlandırmanın gerekçesi yapar; tekil ve çoğul kişi adları aynı eyleyen rolünü taşır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal ekimin bütünü değil, tohumu toprağa koyup üstünü örtme işlemi üzerinden çiftçiyi adlandırır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın kişi adları, tohumu toprakla örten çiftçi anlamında tutulur; dinî kişi nitelemesine veya genel ekim sürecine genişletilmez.

concept_map.definition: Tohumu veya taneyi toprağa yerleştirip üstünü toprakla örten çiftçidir.

facets.statement: Tohumu toprağa yerleştirip üzerini toprakla örten kişi.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar çiftçinin adlandırılmasını tohumu veya taneyi toprakla örtmesine bağlar; tekil ve çoğul biçimler aynı eyleyen rolünü gösterir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Kişiyi yalnızca meslek adıyla değil, tohumu toprakla örtme gerekçesiyle birlikte anlatır.

error_profile.preserves: Çiftçi rolünü ve tohumu toprakla örtme işlemini birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Eylemin gerekçesi bağlamdan açıkça anlaşıldığında doğal kişi adı olarak kullanılabilir.

error_profile.preserves: Toprağı işleyip ekim yapan kişi rolünü korur.
error_profile.adds: Tohumu örtme işiyle sınırlandırılmayan bütün çiftçilik faaliyetlerini kapsar.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal tohumu toprakla örten kişiyi adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal tohumu atma, toprağı ekime hazırlama, ekin ve ekili tarla gibi bütün ekim alanını kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Tohumun toprağa verilmesi ve çiftçinin bu süreçteki rolü iki dalda ortaktır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal eyleyen kişiyi örtme gerekçesiyle niteler; komşu dal ise ekim işlemi, ürün ve tarla dâhil daha geniş bir tarım sürecidir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal çiftçiyi özellikle tohumu toprakla örtmesi bakımından adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal çiftçiyi toprağı yarıp işleyen kişi ve çiftçilik mesleğinin taşıyıcısı olarak adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dalın gönderimi ekim yapan çiftçidir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Gönderim örtüşse de adlandırma sınırı farklıdır: biri tohumu örtme, diğeri toprağı işleme ve meslek yönünü öne çıkarır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; ekim süreci ile genel çiftçi adı, eylem ve eyleyen sınırını açıkladığı için yayımlandı.
